image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a thin branch amidst green foliage. The bird displays characteristic breeding male plumage with a black head, orange-rufous breast, and black upperparts featuring white wing bars. The background consists of blurred leaves and branches, suggesting a natural habitat.
